title: Staging Drift Check
brief: Before promoting a release, our deploy tool compares the routing tree loaded in staging with the one loaded in production. Both are stored as binary trees of TreeNode objects, and any difference, however small, blocks the promotion.
Implement snapshotsMatch(p, q), where p is the root of the staging tree and q is the root of the production tree, and return true if the two trees are exactly the same, and false otherwise.
